meta.name: Alejox Gaming — edit identity
source: reference/channel-page.png (YouTube channel banner + 6 recent thumbnails, captured 2026-09-29)
meta.medium_of_origin: YouTube channel banner and video thumbnails, translated into motion overlays for Remotion
not_copied: The AG triangle logo mark: the kit draws a placeholder monogram; the creator drops the real file at public/logo/alejox-logo.png
Third-party logos seen in thumbnails (OBS, Razer, StreamElements, Claude, DroidCam) — never baked into the kit

soul.one_line: Flat grape-and-cyan diagonal, slanted white-and-yellow condensed caps, lots of footage — loud motion, quiet design.
soul.lineage: MrBeast retention editing (punch-ins, word-pop captions, SFX on every hit) on a Twitch-overlay colour system
soul.read_distance: phone at arm's length — minimum type 28px at 1080px canvas width

colors.name: deep grape
colors.role: brand left half, section cards, panel fill tint

colors.name: electric cyan-blue
colors.role: brand right half, progress, secondary lines

colors.name: highlighter yellow
colors.role: THE accent: one keyword per frame

colors.name: paper white
colors.role: headline line 1, body text, logo disc

colors.name: strike red
colors.role: ONLY the strike-through on an old price / wrong option; never a fill or text

banned: yellow on more than one word per frame
any third brand hue (orange, teal, pink fills)
pastel or desaturated versions of the brand colours

treatment.case: display ALL CAPS; labels ALL CAPS letterspaced 0.18em; body sentence case
treatment.measure: headline max 14 characters per line, max 2 lines
treatment.numerals: Anton for step numbers inside the logo-disc badge

type.headline_recipe: skewX(-8deg); white/yellow; stroke 4% of size; hard shadow 4%; zero blur

space.grid: no grid; anchor to left or right third, never centre for 16:9 overlays
space.alignment: 16:9: left-aligned blocks in the outer third opposite the face; 9:16: centred inside the safe band
space.rhythm: one overlay on screen at a time, 2s minimum between overlays
space.negative_space: the speaker's face — no overlay ever covers it

surface.texture: none — flat fills only (hex pattern removed for minimalism)
surface.edges: cards: 10px radius at 1080p; brand splits: hard diagonal, never rounded
surface.elevation: flat. Headlines keep a thin black stroke (4% of size) + hard shadow 4%, zero blur; everything else no stroke, no shadow
surface.imagery: footage untouched; slow 1.00→1.06 push-in on talking head; screen captures get a 1.15x zoom onto the clicked region
surface.iconography: white filled glyphs inside the white logo disc style badges; one stroke weight

signatures: Diagonal split: grape left, cyan right, seam leans 20° from vertical (top to the right), split near 50/50 — used for section cards and every wipe transition
Headline = two lines, two colours (white / yellow), Anton caps skewed -8°, stroke 4%, hard shadow 4% — display:body >= 5:1
White disc badge sitting ON the seam or card corner, holding the logo or a step number (disc diameter = 1.4x headline cap height)
Yellow covers under 5% of any frame: exactly one keyword
Slam entrance: scale 1.35→1.0 in 7 frames with one small overshoot + whoosh/stamp; exits in 5 frames (exit faster than entrance)
MrBeast rhythm: hard-cut punch-in 1.12x on emphasis words + SFX on every visual hit
Minimal surfaces: solid flat panels (#111111 at 92%), no rims, no textures, no gradients except the brand grape->cyan on bars; max 2 overlay elements on screen

weird_move.what: The yellow keyword punches out of its container
weird_move.how: On every title/section card the yellow line is 8-12% wider than the card and crosses its right edge (or the diagonal seam), rotated an extra -2° vs the rest
weird_move.why: Mirrors the thumbnails where the headline overlaps the subject and the frame edge; it is what makes cards read as 'thumbnail come alive' instead of a lower-third template

archetypes.name: HOOK
archetypes.use: first 1.5s of a video or Short
archetypes.layout: full-frame footage, two-line slam headline in outer third, keyword yellow breaking out

archetypes.name: SECTION
archetypes.layout: full-frame diagonal split wipe, big step number in white disc on the seam, 1-2 word title

archetypes.name: LOWER_THIRD
archetypes.layout: grape→cyan slanted bar bottom-left, logo disc left end, ALEJOXGAMING + tagline

archetypes.name: KEYWORD
archetypes.use: caption only on relevant phrases, never full subtitles
archetypes.layout: bottom band, 1-3 words, Anton caps, white + yellow keyword

archetypes.name: CALLOUT
archetypes.use: pointing at something on a screen capture
archetypes.layout: black rim panel with number disc + label, connector line to the region, zoom 1.15x

archetypes.name: COMPARE
archetypes.layout: two panels on the diagonal split; loser struck through in red

archetypes.name: OUTRO
archetypes.layout: diagonal split background, logo disc on seam, SUSCRÍBETE pill + next-video slots

motion.easing: spring damping 12-14 stiffness 180 for entrances (one overshoot); Easing.in(cubic) for exits
never_moves: logo disc once landed (only a 1-turn spin on entry)

toolkit.@remotion/motion-blur: <CameraMotionBlur> on slams, punch-ins and fast slides only
toolkit.@remotion/layout-utils: fitText for headline lines and breakout overshoot
toolkit.@remotion/noise: impact shake only, <=6 frames, a few px
toolkit.@remotion/paths: evolvePath for callout connectors and strike-throughs
toolkit.not_installed: @remotion/lottie (template look risk), @remotion/three (heavy peer deps, not needed)

voice.register: direct Latin American Spanish, second person (tú)

bans: Never set a headline in Inter or any non-condensed face
Never use a blurred drop shadow or glow on type — hard offset shadow only
Never more than one yellow word per frame
Never centre a 16:9 overlay over the speaker; never cover the face
Never use emoji — use SVG glyphs
Never full-sentence subtitles in 16:9 long videos (keywords only); Shorts use 1-3 word pop captions
Never ease-in-out fades as entrances; overlays slam or wipe
Never particles, confetti, lens flares or light leaks
Never a vertical or horizontal brand split — the seam is always the 20° diagonal
Never translucent/washed fills on the logo disc or brand bars; never a background box behind a single text line
Never decorative rims, glows, textures or patterns
Never more than 2 overlay elements on screen at once
Never stroke or shadow on body/label text

tests.test: Yellow (#F7E000 ±30) covers under 5% of the frame
No more than 3 distinct type sizes in one frame
Display cap height / body cap height >= 5
Every headline is Anton, uppercase, skewed, with black stroke and zero-blur shadow
Title/section cards contain the yellow breakout exactly once
Brand split seam angle is 20° ±3° from vertical
All overlay pixels inside the platform safe area
Entrances land in <= 8 frames, exits <= 5 frames
Squint test: next to the thumbnails, frame reads as the same channel (dark + grape/cyan + yellow/white slanted caps)
Shorts: no stretch longer than 4s without a punch-in, overlay change or cut

gaps_found: LogoDisc rendered translucent pale blue: spec must say SOLID opaque white disc, logo 100% opacity, 3px black ring
Tagline got a highlight-like box: spec must say tagline sits directly on a bar, no text background boxes
Name stroke too heavy on a thin bar: lower third is 2-tier (grape->cyan name bar + black 88% tagline bar), padding >= 0.35x cap height
Critic r1: burned-in source elements (SUSCRITO pill) must never share frame with overlays -> punch-in them out
Critic r1: breakout needs a card/seam to cross, else it doesn't read
Critic r1: outro must use the headline recipe, not a generic pill button
Critic r1: Shorts captions centred on x=540, chunked on phrase boundaries, hidden during hook
Critic r1: lower-third tier 2 must sit on a #111 strip; tier 1 flat grape + 20deg cyan end cap, ends x<=47% width

pacing.punch_in: on emphasis words: hard cut zoom 1.00 -> 1.12 (0 frames, no ease), held until next sentence; max 1 per 4s in long videos, 1 per 2s in Shorts
pacing.captions: long 16:9 videos: KEYWORD archetype only. Shorts: word-pop captions, 1-3 words at a time, each word pops scale 0.6->1 in 3 frames, one yellow keyword per sentence
pacing.counters: numbers/prices animate as a rolling counter (Anton, 6-10 frames) with a tick sfx
pacing.sfx: every overlay entrance gets a sound: stamp for slams, whoosh for wipes, pop for words, riser before reveals
pacing.cut_rhythm: no shot (or static overlay state) longer than ~4s in Shorts without a punch-in, overlay or cut

minimal_vs_mrbeast: Design is quiet (flat, few elements, big negative space); MOTION is loud (slams, punch-ins, motion blur, impact shake, SFX on every hit).
